note: Residents battle each other. Every resident has a Checkling. While a trainer is outdoors, every gapSeconds (a random number between the two) two residents within range tiles of each other, and within seeRange of a trainer, stop and battle where they stand. Turns play every turnMs, the battle ends at maxTurns with more health winning, and trainers nearby can watch it on the battle screen. Nothing a student owns is ever touched.
